scope: Find a safe, non-console path to apply the exact pending Stella desired revision.
user_constraint: The Stella WebUI page has no Console, and the user cannot execute JavaScript there.

source_review.finding: The Save button is disabled unless the form is dirty. Save returns when no fields changed; otherwise it PUTs only changed keys to /api/v1/config and then calls system.applyRevision(nextRevision). This applies a revision created or returned by that save, not an arbitrary existing desired revision.

Startup recovery retries only a pending apply already recorded in sessionStorage. applyRevision calls the authenticated system API; source search found no standalone UI action selecting the existing desired revision.
POST /api/v1/system/apply accepts a revision_id and uses require_auth.
require_auth requires a trusted internal JWT actor or a Bearer/JWT cookie; the apply endpoint does not accept an unauthenticated loopback request.

automation.error: failed to write kernel assets: system path not found (OS error 3)

conclusion: No standalone WebUI apply button or deploy CLI apply command was found. A Settings Save would create/use a new revision after an actual configuration edit; that would add an unrelated configuration change, so it was not used. The exact apply route needs an authenticated browser-context request or a supported UI automation session. No configuration, credentials, or messages were changed/accessed/sent in this check.
next_action: Use Microsoft Edge browser developer tools on the authenticated same-origin Stella page to POST the exact pending revision, or restore a supported UI automation runtime. After an apply response, verify desired/applied equality, bridge enabled groups=1, and active Gateway lease before any fresh marker message.
